description: This file defines the SearchTextProcessor class in the Drupal search module, responsible for processing and analyzing search text, including handling CJK languages, normalization, and tokenization.

classes.name: SearchTextProcessor
classes.description: Implements search text processing for indexing, including text normalization, CJK tokenization, and hook invocation.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Splits analyzed text into an array of words for search indexing.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Performs normalization, diacritics removal, CJK handling, punctuation removal, and truncation on input text.

methods.name: invokePreprocess
methods.description: Calls hook_search_preprocess() to allow modules to preprocess search text.

methods.name: expandCjk
methods.description: Tokenizes CJK text into overlapping sequences based on minimum word size.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates text to 50 characters, removing leading zeros from numeric strings.
